title: FiLM-GPNet: Geometry-Aware Pseudo-Supervised Phase Restoration with Zero-Shot Generalization for Large Temporal InSAR Stacks
abstract: arXiv:2608.29384v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The growing availability of dense commercial Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) time series enables temporal Interferometric SAR (InSAR) analysis, but fixed classical filters fail under heterogeneous acquisition geometries, degrading phase quality and temporal consistency. We propose FiLM-GPNet, a geometry-conditioned network for wrapped-phase restoration that explicitly adapts to acquisition differences using Feature-wise Linear Modulation (FiLM) and a 7D per-pair geometry descriptor. The model is trained with pseudo-supervision from Goldstein-filtered interferograms and regularized by interferometric physics via triplet-closure consistency, while also estimating per-pixel aleatoric uncertainty. Experiments on three Capella Spotlight stacks from the IEEE GRSS 2026 Data Fusion Contest show that FiLM-GPNet reduces temporal residual by 68% (Hawaii) and 66% (Western Australia) relative to the Goldstein baseline, alongside closure error reduct

translated_title: FiLM-GPNet：面向大型时序InSAR数据栈、具备零样本泛化能力的几何感知伪监督相位恢复
translated_abstract: 日益增多的密集商业合成孔径雷达（SAR）时间序列使得时序干涉测量（InSAR）分析成为可能，但固定的经典滤波器在异构采集几何条件下会失效，导致相位质量和时间一致性下降。我们提出了FiLM-GPNet，一种用于缠绕相位恢复的几何条件化网络，它利用特征级线性调制和7维逐对几何描述子，显式地适应采集差异。该模型以Goldstein滤波干涉图作为伪监督进行训练，并通过三重闭合一致性利用干涉测量物理规律进行正则化，同时估计逐像素的偶然不确定性。在IEEE GRSS 2026数据融合竞赛的三个Capella Spotlight数据栈上的实验表明，相对于Goldstein基线，FiLM-GPNet将时间残差降低了68%（夏威夷）和66%（西澳大利亚），同时闭合误差也有所降低（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出FiLM-GPNet，一种利用FiLM几何调制、7维几何描述子和干涉物理正则化的伪监督相位恢复网络，能在异构采集几何下将大型时序InSAR数据的时间残差降低66%–68%，并具备零样本泛化能力。
en_tdlr: FiLM-GPNet is a geometry-conditioned, pseudo-supervised network that adapts to heterogeneous acquisition geometries via FiLM and a 7D per-pair geometry descriptor, reducing temporal residuals by 66–68% over the Goldstein baseline with zero-shot generalization on large temporal InSAR stacks.
